name: webforms
description: Language support for ASP.NET WebForms VB.NET Web Application Projects: .aspx / .ascx / .master highlighting, navigation, completion, diagnostics, designer generation and VB formatting, from the webforms language server.

webforms.server.path.markdownDescription: The `webforms` executable (the `Pharmica.WebForms.Tools` dotnet tool). The default finds it on `PATH` (`dotnet tool install -g Pharmica.WebForms.Tools`).

webforms.server.log.markdownDescription: A file the server appends a request log to (`webforms lsp --log <file>`). Empty: no log.

webforms.generateDesignerOnSave.markdownDescription: Regenerate the `.designer.vb` file when a markup file is saved, as Visual Studio does.

webforms.completion.zeroArgHandlers.markdownDescription: Offer parameterless Subs as event handlers (`OnClick="..."`). Valid VB, but almost any helper Sub qualifies, so they are left out by default.

webforms.codeBlocks.enabled.markdownDescription: VB in markup code blocks (`<% %>`, `<%= %>`, `<%# %>`, `<script runat="server">`): completion, hover, definition and BC errors. Compiles the whole project in the server (about 450 MB per project, dropped after 10 idle minutes).

webforms.diagnostics.staleDesigner.markdownDescription: Report `WF0100` when a saved markup file's `.designer.vb` is out of date or missing (fixed by the *Generate Designer* code action).

webforms.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server (in the output channel).

scripts.package: npm run check && npm run build -- --minify && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('../../artifacts/vsix',{recursive:true})" && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('../../LICENSE','LICENSE')" && vsce package --no-dependencies --out ../../artifacts/vsix/
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node out/test/runTest.js
